name: horror-dark-pov
method: node scripts/style_ref.mjs <ginti ref.mp4> --out templates/visual_targets.horror-dark-pov.json --name horror-dark-pov --margin 0.8 --mood dark. Floors = reference x 0.8, caps = reference x 1.15 / x 1.4, exactly the style_ref rule. Single reference: re-run with more dark-POV references before trusting it as a genre norm.

notes.detail_floors_are_loose: The reference is nearly empty (sharp_edges 0.0031, 13 of 15 grid cells empty, subject 17% of frame), so sharp_edges/empty_cells/subject_scale floors are trivially easy. They are NOT the quality bar: the improvement over the reference is readable set detail inside the light pools (aim for sharp_edges > 0.008 on lit frames).
notes.mean_luma: max 21.8 = reference mean 19 x 1.15. The reference own brightest sampled frame is 40; a sweep peak or the Bhopal board can exceed the cap on a single keyframe by design.
notes.focal: min 6.56 comes from a near-empty frame (one lit blob). Adding more readable detail can lower focal; do not add detail outside the pools just to chase it.
notes.p5_luma: max 12 = the reference worst sampled frame p5 (not part of the style_ref rule; added so crushed blacks are enforced).
notes.reused_backdrop_check_disabled: similarity.backdrop_share_max = 1.0 (cannot trigger). The masked-backdrop fingerprint compares cell colours inside a 0.05 tolerance, and in near-black frames every cell is within that, so ANY dark-POV reel reads as one reused backdrop. Evidence: the Ginti reference itself clusters 9 of 9 shots as one backdrop (share 1.0) under the default thresholds. The near-duplicate check stays on (reference top pair hash_sim 0.875 < 0.88).
notes.focal_decision: 2026-11-27 maintainer decision: focal.min 6.56 (reference x 0.8, from one near-empty reel) is replaced by the horror-night focal floor 2.35 until >= 3 dark-POV reference reels calibrate it. No other floor changed.
notes.color_bins_decision: 2026-11-27 maintainer: max 12 came from a single near-monochrome reference and fails any warm accent (ticket, station board). Falls back to the horror-night cap 40 until >= 3 dark-pov references calibrate it. hue_families still enforces the palette.
